item.subject: science
item.stem:
Rohan is helping his mother in the kitchen of their home in Pune. His hands are wet after washing vegetables, and he needs to switch off the electric mixer at the wall socket.
Which statement is correct?

options.A: It is safe for Rohan to touch the switch because the mixer is not running.
options.B: Rohan should dry his hands before touching the switch, because the human body conducts electricity and wet skin increases the risk of a dangerous current passing through the body.
options.C: It is safe for Rohan to touch the switch briefly if he is careful.
options.D: Rohan should pour water over the socket first to make it safe to touch.
